description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt/LEDE project, defining functions and variables for platform-specific image checking, upgrading, and configuration copying for various hardware boards. It contains logic for handling different board types and executing appropriate upgrade procedures.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the provided image is compatible with the current board by identifying the board name and applying specific validation logic for supported boards.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process based on the board type, invoking specific upgrade functions such as eMMC, SD card, or NAND upgraders.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the configuration data to the hardware, with logic customized for specific board types.
